audit.whatIsWrong: All seven chart rows disagreed between layers: phases[].side was Skill on every row, while win[] read Ekko/Akali/Akali/Ekko/Akali/Akali/Akali.
audit.why: 49.78% over 2686 games is dead even and the chart should show real ownership swings rather than seven shrugs. Ekko owns level 1 (Timewinder 1075 vs Akali's 550 Q, and it damages on the return) and 4-5 (Phase Dive at 8s resetting his auto, Parallel Convergence shielding the trade back). Akali owns level 3 and first item. Level 6 is genuinely split because Chronobreak goes untargetable straight through Perfect Execution.
audit.corrected: Reconciled chart, both layers, matched pairs: Ekko, Skill, Akali, Ekko, Skill, Akali, Akali.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3] and the late-game text credited Ekko's scaling to 'instant-cast Z-Drive Resonance from stealth or brush' — Z-Drive Resonance is his passive: bonus damage on every third hit against the SAME target, plus a move-speed burst. It is not a cast, not a pick tool, and cannot be used from brush.
audit.why: Riot's passive text is unambiguous. The packet also flagged 'Drive Resonance' as a probable wrong name in the same field.
audit.corrected: spikes[3].text and late rewritten around what actually scales — Parallel Convergence's 1600-range placement and Chronobreak falling to 50 seconds.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four interactions were flagged as missing and none reached the page. Chronobreak makes Ekko UNTARGETABLE, which dodges the Perfect Execution re-cast outright, and it heals a percentage of damage received — Grievous Wounds is a matchup item here. Parallel Convergence only stuns if EKKO enters the anomaly, and it shields him when he does. Phase Dive is an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up auto is the tell. Additionally, the mid-game text claimed shroud lets you 'approach without eating a Parallel Convergence stun' — the anomaly stuns everyone caught inside it, so the shroud hides you from his aim, not from the zone.
audit.why: All four are in Riot's own descriptions, and the brief lists all four under missingInteractions (untargetable-dodges-burst, needs-antiheal, shield-absorbs-burst, autoreset-burst-tell).
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d, breakdown.carry, breakdown.feeding, enemyWin, mid and several whys rewritten to carry them.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers on the page at all.
audit.why: Parallel Convergence 22/20/18/16/14 is the punishable one; Chronobreak is 110/80/50; Phase Dive is 9/8.5/8/7.5/7 at only 325 range.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[2].d, phases[1].why and whys[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: Grievous Wounds was never mentioned despite Chronobreak's heal being the single reason Akali's burst fails here.
audit.why: Chronobreak heals a percentage of damage received during the rewind window.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds now named in breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.feeding, whys[5] and phases[5].why.

edits.before: Q the wave edge and his toes — the energy crunch is real, so every kama needs to farm AND poke at once.
edits.after: Timewinder reaches 1075 to your 550 and damages twice, out and back — do not contest the level 1 wave.

edits.before: More Q pressure — hold the energy bar above 100 so a real trade window never finds you broke.
edits.after: Parallel Convergence lands from 1600 range and is 22s at rank 1 — respect where he plants it.

edits.before: Shroud online: the trade pattern is Q-auto, shroud the answer, Q again from the smoke. Most mids lose this exchange.
edits.after: Shroud online, but the anomaly stuns everyone inside it — break his vision before he places it, not after.

edits.before: Passive-weave every trade: spell, walk out of the ring, auto the edge — the energy refunds pay the whole lane.
edits.after: Phase Dive is 8s and resets his auto; Parallel Convergence shields him. Extended trades belong to Ekko now.

edits.before: Perfect Execution online — the double-dash R turns half-health mages into clean-up duty. Look for the all-in.
edits.after: Both ults land: Chronobreak goes untargetable through your execute, so R only after he has spent it.

edits.before: First item spike: shroud trades become kill threats. Force the wave contact and punish every spell he whiffs.
edits.after: First item: burst him past the Chronobreak rewind in one window, and Grievous Wounds cuts the heal it pays.

edits.before: Late Akali erases carries: R in through the front line, shroud the response, E-reset out with the kill.
edits.after: Late you still win the isolated 1v1 — R in, shroud the answer, and E-reset out before Chronobreak is back.

edits.before: Ekko: at level 1 Ekko's poke and stun trap out-trade Akali's early kit.
edits.after: Ekko: Timewinder covers 1075 to Akali's 550 and damages on the way back too.

edits.before: Akali: by level 2 Akali's mobility starts closing the gap Ekko relies on.
edits.after: Skill: Parallel Convergence reaches 1600, but it only stuns if Ekko walks in.

edits.before: Akali: level 3 unlocks Akali's dash-recast, letting her punish Ekko's ability cooldown windows.
edits.after: Akali: level 3 E-recast punishes Phase Dive's 8s cooldown, and its 325 range cannot answer a flip.

edits.before: Ekko: levels 4-5 still favor Ekko as his combo damage and escape tools scale ahead of Akali's power spikes.
edits.after: Ekko: levels 4-5 favor Ekko as Phase Dive resets his auto and Parallel Convergence shields the trade back.

edits.before: Akali: level 6 gives Akali a decisive burst-execute that beats Ekko's all-in if she finishes the combo quickly.
edits.after: Skill: Chronobreak goes untargetable straight through Perfect Execution, so the 6 race turns on who spends first.

edits.before: Akali: first item burst lets Akali kill before Chronobreak rewinds enough HP to save Ekko.
edits.after: Akali: first item burst kills past the Chronobreak rewind, and Grievous Wounds cuts the heal.

edits.before: Akali: with full burst, Akali still wins isolated 1v1s even though Ekko has better teamfight pick potential late.
edits.after: Akali: Z-Drive Resonance needs three hits on the same target — she is gone before the third one lands.

edits.before: - Ekko Chronobreak: matchup-defining — Erases your kill and bursts back — track the hologram and save final damage for after it. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Twilight Shroud has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Ekko Chronobreak: he goes untargetable and heals a share of the damage you just dealt — hold your execute until it is spent, and buy Grievous Wounds to cut the rewind. - Parallel Convergence is 22s at rank 1 and only stuns if Ekko walks into it. - Phase Dive is 8s and only 325 range.

edits.before: Erases your kill and bursts back — track the hologram and save final damage for after it. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: He goes untargetable and heals off the damage you dealt — hold your execute until Chronobreak is spent, then go.

edits.before: Ekko spends Chronobreak early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Chronobreak spent leaves 50 seconds of a mid laner with 325 range of dash. Go.

edits.before: That’s Ekko’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Chronobreak dodges your execute outright — never open the level 6 race first.

edits.before: The shroud spent farming is the dive you can't answer — W is your Flash, your Zhonya's, and your opening all at once.
edits.after: Parallel Convergence shields him as it stuns you — force the anomaly out before you spend both E casts going in.

edits.before: Carry through deletions — one carry per fight, every fight; the shroud buys the time and the resets pay the exit.
edits.after: Ekko rewinds; you do not. Force Chronobreak out first, then take the second fight where he has no reset left.

edits.before: If Ekko takes first blood, tighten up: Chronobreak is now always up in your head. A second kill means the duel is over and the game isn’t — farm with Q range and stay relevant through shroud picks.
edits.after: If Ekko takes first blood, stop trying to out-burst the rewind — buy Grievous Wounds and never fight near a planted anomaly. Farm at Q range and stay relevant through shroud picks.

edits.before: Ekko wins by landing Chronobreak, denying your pattern, and cashing the all-in before your pattern matures.
edits.after: Ekko wins by stunning you in the anomaly, shielding the trade, then rewinding untargetable out of your execute.

edits.before: Ekko out-scales into a pick-and-teamfight threat with Z-Drive Resonance, but your all-in burst still wins isolated 1v1s.
edits.after: Ekko out-scales into a teamfight threat with Chronobreak resets, but your all-in burst still wins the isolated 1v1.

edits.before: Ekko becomes a pick-potential terror with instant-cast Z-Drive Resonance from stealth or brush, so don't get caught alone without vision. Still, in a straight 1v1 your burst combo kills him before Chronobreak timer expires as long as you commit fully rather than poking him down slowly.
edits.after: Ekko becomes a pick threat because Parallel Convergence lands from 1600 range and Chronobreak is only 50 seconds late, so don't get caught alone without vision. In a straight 1v1 your burst still kills him inside the Chronobreak window, as long as you commit fully rather than poking him down slowly.

edits.before: Level 6 is a mutual all-in threat, but the key is to finish him fast: Chronobreak rewinds him to HP from a few seconds prior, so a clean uninterrupted burst denies its value while a drawn-out fight lets him escape and reset. Track his W stun-cloud cooldown before diving, and use your own W stealth to approach without eating a Parallel Convergence stun. He roams well with Phase Dive, so ward river to prevent free plates elsewhere.
edits.after: Level 6 is a mutual all-in threat, but the key is to finish him fast: Chronobreak rewinds him to HP from a few seconds prior and he is untargetable throughout, so a clean uninterrupted burst denies its value while a drawn-out fight lets him reset. Track Parallel Convergence — the anomaly stuns everyone caught inside, so shroud hides you from his aim but not from the zone itself. He roams well with Phase Dive, so ward river to prevent free plates elsewhere.

notes: Z-Drive Resonance is Ekko's PASSIVE (third hit on the same target), not a castable pick tool — the late-game text and spikes[3] both described it as an instant-cast from brush. Corrected both. Also corrected the claim that Twilight Shroud avoids the Parallel Convergence stun: the anomaly stuns everyone inside it; the shroud only denies him the aim. All seven chart rows disagreed between layers, so the whole chart is reproposed in matched pairs with no-op rows included to keep the atomic group complete.
